E-GO.summary: Go-owned typed keyed child collection, native trace executable and tests. Propose/freeze the contract first; add/remove/reorder/reuse keys with generation-correlated pending requests and child-first clear cancellation, reuse counter/Gobi.

E-COMPILER.summary: Compile the new Go slice/value collection through existing GoScript CLI and encoder; diagnose actual unsupported shape and minimally repair only if needed, preserving old profiles. Implementation gated on Go contract freeze.

E-HOST.summary: Reuse shared host and explicit capabilities, add closed collection effect token policy/driver; no JS domain reducer. Implementation gated on Go contract freeze.

E-HARNESS.owner: compiled-children/conformance/** EXCEPT check.test.mjs and seeded.test.mjs (N5 ownership after explicit handoff)
E-HARNESS.summary: Deterministic native/direct/React/DOM replay, real mounted events/swaps/stale callbacks, state/tree/DOM/disabled/event ordering and mutation controls. Gated on frozen Go/runtime/compiler interfaces.

E-ORACLE.summary: Independent literal scenario/expectations and negative checker controls, review Go invariants without copying implementation. First propose scenario to Go owner; implementation gated on contract freeze.

E-DELIVERY.summary: Executable HTTP demo plus full inherited capability regression and new two-backend build/replay runner, immutable provenance/archive checks, scoped CI. Gated on frozen interfaces.

E-CHECKER-TESTS.summary: Independent adversarial checker and deterministic seed tests, actual native trace plus literal oracle; no fabricated positive browser evidence. N4 explicitly handed off these not-yet-created files to free N5; checker implementation and full integration remain N4-owned.

E-FIX-ORACLE-CUSTODY.summary: Preserve unrecoverable old hash mismatch explicitly. Freshly validate current/new read-only audit helper and create hash-consistent superseding oracle evidence packet without rewriting original E-ORACLE report/receipt or core oracle data.

E-FIX-INHERITED-GATE.summary: Bind inherited evidence to invocation freshness, actual source/report/archive/manifest bytes; meaningful rejection tests; isolate preserved Go proof files from root package discovery. Coordinate new unit paths with other repair owners.

E-FIX-WASM-OBSERVABILITY.summary: Fail closed if WebAssembly observation cannot install; record explicit coverage and precise guarantees; test missing/locked hooks and normal installation. No application or checker source ownership.

E-FIX-SEEDED-ASSERTIONS.summary: Assert complete input operation tuples and derive six-child input schedule bound, plus meaningful corruption rejection; no Go app reducer/browser fixture generation.

E-FIX-HARNESS-LIVENESS.summary: Bind compatible swap candidate/backend and live post-rejection click to actual active renderer identities; reject reviewer witness via meaningful new controls; coordinate WASM guard coverage assertion with N2.

E-RELEASE-DOCS.summary: Stable executable reproduction/backend-contract guide with precise author versus final acceptance boundaries, current finite Go keyed collection scope and another backend requirements. Final exact-source acceptance remains pending separate immutable evidence.

E-AUTHOR-CUSTODY.summary: Prepare streaming hash-bound immutable archive/inventory of frozen pre-repair author/review raw evidence, preserving rejected attempts and historical gaps explicitly; no claim of final acceptance and no live repair file capture.

E-FIX-RELEASE-PATHS.summary: Correct factual artifact locations: attempt logs/builds/rawcaptures/demo inside attempt; canonical report/receipt incoordination; archive/manifest siblings. No cosmetic edits or successclaims.

E-FIX-ATTEMPT-FRESHNESS.summary: Close reproduced one-millisecond pre-invocation attempt timestamp gap: both attempt time and receipt startedAt must be >= invocationStartedAt. Preserve previous version, add boundary witness regression, no broader sourcechanges.
